schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.subtitle: Fixed recordings that repeat automatically every week.
schedule.wakeDesc: The computer wakes automatically 10 minutes before the recording starts
schedule.wakeStatusPermission: Missing permission — click Schedule and approve
schedule.protectTitle: Protect ongoing recordings from accidental stop
schedule.protectDesc: Requires confirmation before stopping an ongoing recording
schedule.wakeCannotOff: Cannot start from fully powered off
schedule.wakeTipNote: Tip: leave the computer in sleep (don't shut it down) when you head home on Saturday evening. Macs won't wake on battery — keep the power adapter plugged in.
schedule.silenceDesc: Ends the recording if the audio stays silent for more than 5 minutes
schedule.splitDesc: Creates a new audio file every hour — easier to edit afterwards
schedule.autostartReminder: The recording has been added. But SundayRec does not start automatically with the machine, so a scheduled recording will not happen if the machine has been off or the app is closed. We can turn auto-start on now — it takes no space on screen, the app runs quietly in the background.
schedule.noSlotsTitle: No weekly recordings set up yet
schedule.noSlotsHint: Click “Add a time” below to start a recurring weekly recording — e.g. Sunday at 11.
schedule.sleepFixNoAdmin: Needs administrator rights — run SundayRec as administrator
schedule.reminderDesc: System notification N minutes before a scheduled recording starts
schedule.manualMaxDesc: Stops automatically after the set time — keeps files from getting huge if you forget to stop
schedule.preRollDesc: Starts the recording N seconds in the past, so the opening of the talk is there even if you press a little late. Requires the buffer to actually be running — it starts automatically once you enable it below.
schedule.sleepStatusOk: Sleep settings look good — wake-up will work
schedule.sleepStatusMacWarn: Autopoweroff is on — your Mac may shut down during sleep
schedule.sleepStatusWinWarn: Wake timers aren't enabled — wake-up may fail
schedule.sleepFixOk: Fixed — sleep settings are now optimal
schedule.sleepFixCancelled: Cancelled — approve the permission prompt to fix
schedule.sleepAlwaysOffNote: Want the machine to always start recordings? Leave it in sleep (don’t shut it down) and turn on “Start automatically with Windows/Mac” under System.
schedule.platformMacArm: Apple Silicon Mac (M-series) — can wake from sleep, not from shutdown
schedule.platformMacIntel: Intel Mac — can wake from sleep and shutdown (manual activation required for the latter)
schedule.platformWin: Windows — can wake from sleep; cold-start from full shutdown requires BIOS configuration
schedule.platformLinux: Linux — automatic wake is not supported
schedule.platformOther: Platform not supported for automatic wake
schedule.weeklyDesc: Fixed recordings that repeat every week — for example a service every Sunday. The machine starts and stops the recording automatically, even if nobody is present.
schedule.errTimeFormat: Write the time as HH:MM, e.g. 11:00.
schedule.errSameTime: The stop time cannot be the same as the start.
schedule.errMaxRange: Maximum duration must be between 1 and 480 minutes.
schedule.prerollEnabledDesc: The buffer keeps the microphone open in the background at all times. While it runs it is also what feeds the level meters on Home, so they keep working as before. Turn it on if you need the seconds before you press record — Home shows when the buffer is running.
schedule.errCancelTestWake: Could not cancel the wake test.

power.onBattery: On battery — wake will likely fail.

standby.warning: Standby (deep sleep) is enabled — it can break wake on Apple Silicon.

verify.checking: Checking what's actually scheduled in the OS…
verify.none: No wake jobs expected — you have no upcoming recordings.
verify.mismatch: confirmed in the OS — some are missing. Click “Schedule wake-up” to set them again.

test.confirm: The computer will sleep for up to 60 seconds and then try to wake itself. Close any unsaved work first.

summary.offSub: Scheduled recordings only start if the machine is on and the app is running. Turn wake-up on under Details if the machine is allowed to sleep.
summary.mismatchTitle: The operating system is missing some wake-ups
summary.okNext: Next wake-up {when} — {n} minutes before the recording starts.
summary.okNoNext: No upcoming recording to wake up for right now.
summary.neverTested: Never tested. Run «Test wake now» under Details before the first service.

calendar.name: NAME (suggestion from the church calendar)
calendar.errNoDate: Pick a date in the calendar.
calendar.hintShort: Click a day to add a recording

audio.classicFfmpegDesc: SundayRec normally records audio with the new built-in engine, which reads audio straight from the sound device and writes the file itself. Turn this on only if recording fails on this machine — the old ffmpeg path is used instead.
audio.sampleRateAutoDesc: Follows the sound card — no resampling
audio.benchRunning: Measuring for 60 s — play audio/speak into the microphone …
audio.scanRunning: Listening for 3 s — play audio on the channels …
audio.scanNone: No channels with signal — play audio and try again
audio.deviceHelp: Choose the mixer or audio interface that records the church's sound. A USB mixer is recommended over the built-in microphone.
audio.deviceNotShown: Don't see the right device? Check that the interface is connected and its driver is installed.
audio.healthDesc: Run these before a service to be sure the recording will start without problems. We recommend a test recording before the first service after anything changes (new mixer, new gear, an update).
audio.classicDshowDesc: SundayRec normally uses a modern Windows audio engine (WASAPI, or ASIO for pro gear). Turn this on only if recording is unstable on this machine — the old DirectShow path is used instead.
audio.gridDesc: The interface's channels are shown live — channels carrying audio light up. Tap the channel you want to record.
audio.gridFailed: No live signal from the device — pick channels manually, or use the scan.
audio.gridTapHint: Tap the channel for left, then the channel for right.
audio.gridTapHintMono: Tap the channel carrying signal to select it.
audio.diagDeviceListTitle: Every audio device the recorder can see

files.smartNameDesc: The app recognises church holidays and uses the correct name automatically.
files.autoDeleteDesc: Frees up disk space automatically by removing old recordings
files.trimSilenceDesc: Automatically trims silent seconds at the start and end of the recording
files.confirmAutoDeleteShort: Recordings older than {n} days are deleted automatically and cannot be recovered.
files.behaviourDesc: Fine-tune how the recording starts, is protected, and split.
files.saveFolderDesc: All recordings end up here as local files. Tip: pick a folder on an external drive if you record often and have a large disk.

general.emailErrorDesc: Sends an email to the person in charge if the recording fails
general.autoStartDesc: Runs quietly in the background — nothing for you to do
general.autoUpdateDesc: Downloads and installs new versions quietly in the background
general.updateChannelDesc: Stable is versions that have been through a real service. Beta is newer and less proven.
general.updateChannelBetaBody: Beta versions reach you before they have been tried on a real service. They can contain faults nobody has found yet — including faults that ruin a recording. Do not run beta on the machine that records the service unless you are prepared to deal with it. You can switch back to Stable at any time.
general.updateChannelActiveBeta: This machine gets BETA versions — newer, and not tried on a service.
general.askOpenEditorDesc: Show a prompt to open the file in the Editor once a recording finishes
general.notifyStartDesc: Shown as a system notification when a scheduled recording begins.
general.notifyStopDesc: Click the notification to jump straight to the file.
general.diagnoseHint: Copy this and send to support if recording is not working.
general.helpDesc: Reopen the setup guide — useful when a new person takes over, or if you just want to check that everything is set up correctly.
general.langCardDesc: Choose your preferred language. SundayRec supports seven languages — all menus and notifications adapt immediately.
general.logHint: If something goes wrong, this log can be sent to whoever is helping you. It contains no audio and no passwords.
general.showLogFailed: Could not open the log folder.
general.logEmpty: The log is empty so far.
general.profileDesc: Used in file names, notification emails and the podcast RSS. These fields are optional but recommended.
general.responsibleHint: The person who gets an e-mail if a recording fails (requires e-mail alerts under Sharing → Notifications).
general.cspError: Configuration error: camera preview will not work (CSP blocks blob: URLs). Restart the app — if the problem persists, contact support.
general.initError: Startup error: parts of the app may be missing or not working. Restart the app — if the problem persists, contact support.
general.telemetryCardDesc: Help Sunday Suite make SundayRec better with anonymous diagnostics. Optional, and off by default — it changes nothing about how SundayRec works.
general.telemetryToggleDesc: Crash reports, quality data and named usage counters — never audio, sermon text or names.
general.telemetryQueuePendingOne: 1 report is waiting to be sent.
general.telemetryQueuePendingMany: {n} reports are waiting to be sent.
general.telemetryDeleteConfirmBody: This replaces your anonymous install ID with a new one and clears any reports still waiting to be sent — both happen locally, right away. SundayRec then asks the server to delete everything stored under the old ID. If the machine is offline, the request is sent as soon as it is back online. Anonymous totals remain, since they contain no install ID and cannot be linked to you.
general.telemetryDeleteConfirmYes: Yes, clear and get a new ID
general.telemetryDeletedToast: Your local data was cleared and you now have a new anonymous ID.
general.telemetryDeleteFailedToast: Could not delete the data. Try again.
general.telemetryPreviewNextHint: This is exactly what would be sent next.
general.telemetryPreviewHistoryHint: Diagnostics are off. This shows the shape of the data from your own local history — nothing is sent.
general.learningCardDesc: These observations exist so the automatic detection can get better — your corrections are what teach it. Nothing here is shared with anyone unless anonymous diagnostics is switched on.
general.learningCardWhere: Everything is stored locally, next to the recording it belongs to. Deleting a recording deletes its observations too.
general.learningLoadBtn: Show what the app has noticed
general.learningLoadFailed: Could not load the overview. Try again.
general.learningUnavailableRecording: Not available while a recording is running.
general.learningEmptyBody: Nothing to show yet — that's normal. This fills in only when you correct something the app got wrong.
general.learningSermonPickZero: The automatic sermon pick has not been corrected yet.
general.learningSermonPickOne: The automatic sermon pick has been corrected 1 time.
general.learningSermonPickMany: The automatic sermon pick has been corrected {n} times.
general.learningStartTooEarly: The automatic start often lands too early — on average you have moved it {n} seconds later.
general.learningStartTooLate: The automatic start often lands too late — on average you have moved it {n} seconds earlier.
general.learningEndTooEarly: The automatic end is often cut too early — on average you have moved it {n} seconds later.
general.learningEndTooLate: The automatic end often lands too late — on average you have moved it {n} seconds earlier.
general.learningCompanionSummary: Of the AI suggestions, {accepted} were used ({edited} rewritten afterwards), and {leftAlone} were left alone.
general.localNudgeCardDesc: If you correct the same thing every Sunday, the app can move its own suggestion that way — for this machine alone. Nothing here is shared with anyone, and you can reset it at any time.
general.localNudgeToggle: Let the app learn from my corrections
general.localNudgeToggleHint: When this is on, the app moves its own suggested sermon start and end toward the way you usually correct them. Never by more than {limit} seconds, and never before you have corrected at least {min} recordings.
general.localNudgeOff: The app does not adjust its own suggestions. It guesses in exactly the same way as a freshly installed app.
general.localNudgeWaiting: The app has not adjusted anything yet. It waits until you have corrected at least {min} recordings — so far it has {samples}.
general.localNudgeOn: The app has adjusted its own suggestions based on your corrections:
general.localNudgeStartLater: The app now suggests that the sermon starts {n} seconds later than it otherwise would. That is based on {samples} corrections from you.
general.localNudgeStartEarlier: The app now suggests that the sermon starts {n} seconds earlier than it otherwise would. That is based on {samples} corrections from you.
general.localNudgeEndLater: The app now suggests that the sermon ends {n} seconds later than it otherwise would. That is based on {samples} corrections from you.
general.localNudgeEndEarlier: The app now suggests that the sermon ends {n} seconds earlier than it otherwise would. That is based on {samples} corrections from you.
general.localNudgeAtLimit: Your corrections point further still, but the app never moves a suggestion by more than {limit} seconds. If the suggestion is still wide of the mark, it is the recordings that need a look — not this setting.
general.localNudgeResetBtn: Reset what the app has learned
general.localNudgeResetDone: Reset. The app now guesses in exactly the same way as a freshly installed app, and will not learn any more until you switch this back on.
general.localNudgeLoadFailed: Could not fetch what the app has adjusted. Please try again.
general.settingsProfileDesc: Save every setting as a single file — as a backup, or to set up another machine identically (e.g. via a USB stick). Passwords and stream keys are never included.
general.settingsProfileHint: Import replaces the settings on this machine. Out-of-range values are adjusted automatically.
general.settingsImportConfirm: This replaces the settings on this machine with the file's contents. Recordings, history and passwords are untouched.

editor.layersNotAnalyzed: Run «Analyse recording» under Clip tools to see speech, music and silence here.

editor.errFileNotFound: Original file is not available — is the disk disconnected?
editor.errCutData: Internal error in cut data. Try reloading the file.
editor.chaptersEmpty: No chapters yet. Click "+ Add at playhead" to start.

master.useExportHint: — to export with mastering, use the Export button

manual.title: Start manual recording
manual.subtitle: Recording starts straight away and you stop it yourself when you're done.

recording.finalizingHint: One moment — the audio is being written to file.
recording.finalizeTimeout: The recording is taking unusually long to finish. Check that the file was saved.
recording.confirmBody: The recording will be saved up to this point.

recording.errorDeviceNotFound: Audio device not found — check the USB connection
recording.errorNotReadable: The audio device is in use by another application

recording.errorEmpty: The recording is empty — no audio reached the app from the device
recording.errorFolderPermission: No access to the save folder — make sure it's writable
recording.errorFolderError: Can't create the save folder — check disk space and permissions
recording.errorDeviceDisconnected: The audio device was disconnected during recording — check the connection

recording.errorInvalidOpts: Invalid recording settings — restart and try again
recording.errorNoSaveFolder: No save folder selected — go to Settings → Recording
recording.errorUnknown: Something went wrong during recording — check that the audio device and save folder are ready
recording.silenceWarn: Silence detected — the recording will stop automatically if the silence continues.
recording.autostopFailed: Could not change the auto-stop. The recording continues — stop it manually if you need to.

video.title: Video recording
video.enableDesc: Captures video alongside audio for every recording
video.cameraSearchPrompt: Click Refresh to search for cameras
video.cameraHint: USB webcams and HDMI capture cards are supported on macOS and Windows.
video.outputFormatDesc: Choose whether audio and video are combined in one file or saved separately.
video.combinedDesc: Audio + video in one file — ready for YouTube
video.separateDesc: Audio and video are saved separately
video.splitWarning: File splitting is active — video is always saved as a separate file regardless of the choice above. Disable automatic splitting in schedule settings to combine audio and video into one MP4.
video.splitHint: When automatic file splitting is enabled, separate files are always used.
video.keepAudioDesc: Also saves the high-quality audio file alongside the combined MP4
video.hwEncodeDesc: Uses hardware encoding (VideoToolbox) for faster video export on Mac. Falls back to software automatically if it fails.
video.encoderHint: Hardware (VideoToolbox, Mac only): low CPU use → smooth live preview, less heat/battery, and real-time 4K/H.265. Very good quality at sufficient bitrate — recommended for most. Software (x264/x265): slightly better quality per file size, but uses a lot of CPU and can make the preview and meters choppy during recording — choose it when quality per byte matters most and the machine isn’t doing anything else.
video.probeFailed: Could not read the camera’s resolutions — limited to 1080p to avoid upscaling. 4K requires a camera that delivers true 4K.
video.resUnsupportedShort: Selected resolution is not supported — set to the camera’s max.

onboarding.welcomeDesc: Let’s set up the app in a few minutes, so everything is ready for Sunday.
onboarding.featDevice: Choose a mixer or audio interface
onboarding.deviceTitle: Which audio device do you use?
onboarding.deviceDesc: Choose the mixer or audio interface connected to the computer.
onboarding.deviceNone: No audio devices found. Check that the mixer is connected via USB.
onboarding.deviceMixerHint: Mixer / audio interface — recommended for services
onboarding.errNoDevice: Choose an audio device before continuing
onboarding.testDesc: Say something into the microphone, or play audio through the mixer. Check that the indicator moves.
onboarding.vuTooLoud: Too loud — turn down the volume on the mixer
onboarding.vuError: Could not start the audio test — check that permission is granted in system settings.
onboarding.schedDesc: SundayRec can start and stop the recording automatically — without anyone having to remember it.
onboarding.doneDesc: SundayRec is ready to record services. You can change all settings in the menu at any time.
onboarding.tipHomeText: Check status, run a test recording, and see the next scheduled recording
onboarding.tipScheduleText: Add weekly recordings and special days (Christmas, Easter)
onboarding.tipAudioText: Switch mixer, adjust volume and run test recordings
onboarding.tipPublishText: Connect Google Drive / Dropbox / OneDrive for automatic cloud backup
onboarding.testWaitHint: The button unlocks as soon as the meter picks up sound.
onboarding.testBlockedHint: The audio test could not start. Continue and test the sound from Settings → Audio later.
onboarding.consentTitle: Would you like to help us improve SundayRec?
onboarding.consentDesc: You can share anonymous diagnostics and usage statistics with Sunday Suite, who develop SundayRec. It's always optional and changes nothing about how the app works — you can change your answer any time under Settings → System.
onboarding.consentCatCrash: Crash reports — error type, the program's error message, app and OS version. File paths are scrubbed out. Never text from the sermon.
onboarding.consentCatQuality: Quality data — whether a recording came through complete (loss percentage, verdict), coarse ranges for your corrections in the editor, e.g. “30–60 seconds earlier”, and which kinds of automatic suggestion you use — title, summary or chapter marks — and whether you kept or rewrote the result. Never the audio content or any text. The time it happened is included, without your time zone.
onboarding.consentCatUsage: Feature usage — which features you use, e.g. «export to MP3». Counts only, never content.
onboarding.consentNever: Never: audio, transcripts, sermon text, names, e-mail, device names or church names.
onboarding.consentNote: Whatever you answer, SundayRec works exactly the same.
onboarding.promptDesc: SundayRec can send anonymous error and usage statistics to Sunday Suite to improve the app. Optional, and you can answer any time under Settings → System.
onboarding.rePromptDesc: You have answered this before, but we are asking again because what would be shared has been extended: your corrections in the editor can now also say roughly how far an automatic suggestion was moved — for example “30–60 seconds earlier” — and not only that it was moved. The app can also say which kind of suggestion you used — a title, a summary or chapter marks — and whether you kept it as it was or rewrote it. The text itself is never sent. Your previous answer has not been assumed, neither as a yes nor as a no, and nothing is sent until you answer here.

tooltip.jumpToClip: Click to jump to first clip

transcript.title: Transcription
transcript.empty: No transcription yet. Click "Transcribe" to create searchable text from the speech.
transcript.modalDesc: Uses local AI (whisper.cpp) — no data sent to the cloud. Choose model and language.
transcript.translateToEn: Translate to English at the same time
transcript.unavailableHint: Transcription is not available in this version of the app on this machine.
transcript.errNoBinary: Whisper is not available on this platform. Contact support.
transcript.chaptersNoneFound: No topic chapters found in the talk

companion.title: Sermon helper
companion.unavailable: AI sermon helper isn't available right now. Transcript and chapters still work.
companion.modeAiHint: An API key is configured — the summary is produced by a language model
companion.modeLocalHint: No API key — the summary is produced locally on this device
companion.sourceAiHint: The summary was produced by a language model on the server
companion.sourceLocalHint: Local summary (no API key) — entirely on-device
companion.useMetaHint: Put the title + summary in metadata — used on export and by SundayEdit/Stage
companion.settingsDesc: Chapters and quotes are always produced locally on this device. For a nicer summary and title you can paste an Anthropic API key — it's stored only in the OS keychain, never in settings. Without a key, a local summary is used.
companion.keyNone: No key — the local summary is used

search.title: History
search.subtitle: Search sermon text or filename, and browse your full recording history. Click a text hit to open the recording at that point.
search.noRecordingsDesc: Once you record a service it shows up here. Transcribe a recording in Edit to search inside the sermon text.

default.title: Default episode artwork
default.subtitle: Used as cover art for every sermon unless you override it per episode.

thumbnail.dropHint: Drop an image here, or click to choose

warning.tooSmall: Recommended size is at least 1400×1400 pixels
warning.tooLarge: Files over 5 MB may slow recording and upload

error.unsupported: Unsupported image format. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.

dialog.autostartTitle: Should the recording start by itself?
dialog.noScreensBody: Check that the app has screen-recording permission in your system settings.
dialog.deleteTranscriptBody: The recording itself is kept. You can transcribe it again later.
dialog.discardEditsBody: The cuts you have made will be lost. The recording file itself is untouched.
dialog.discardEpisodeBody: The recording is kept, but it will not be published.

missed.hint: Check that the machine was on, that SundayRec was running and that “Wake the computer automatically” is enabled.

guard.title: {what} now?
guard.duringRecording: A recording is running right now. The change can interrupt or ruin what is being recorded.
guard.beforeRecording: The next scheduled recording starts in {n} minutes. The change will affect that recording.

sharing.publishDesc: Cloud backup, podcast and live streaming — where the recording goes after the service.
sharing.notifyDesc: Who is told when a recording starts, stops or fails.

health.micDenied: Microphone access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and enable SundayRec.
health.micRestricted: Microphone access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.cameraDenied: Camera access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera and enable SundayRec.
health.cameraRestricted: Camera access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Video recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.ffmpegMissing: The bundled audio engine (ffmpeg) was not found. Video, export and editing will not work — reinstall the app.
health.denied: Denied — open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone
health.notAsked: Not asked yet — the first recording triggers the prompt
health.cannotTell: Cannot be determined on this platform

deeplink.captionsNoRecording: Captions received, but without saying which recording they belong to. Open the recording in the editor and import the text there.
deeplink.rejectedPath: Captions were refused: the file path could not be approved. Import the text from the editor instead.
deeplink.rejectedType: Captions were refused: the file is not a subtitle file (.srt or .vtt).
deeplink.rejectedOutside: Captions were refused: the recording is outside your recordings folder. SundayRec only writes next to its own recordings.
deeplink.rejectedExpired: The request has expired. Send the captions again from SundayEdit.
deeplink.importRejected: The file could not be opened: SundayRec only opens audio and video files from a known folder.
deeplink.confirmCaptionsBody: Another app sent the text file “{file}”. If you say yes, the text is saved next to the recording.
